'''Vex Dantos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Pureblood]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he resided at the [[Outpost Overseer]] on [[Voss]], where he asked an Imperial to deal with [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] investigating ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ruins.<ref name="SWTOR" />
